source: Number codes of keyword arguments (decision E1) that the shared_a trees need. (1) zin_politics_add_drift: the politics spec (docs/specs/00_foundation/02_ideologies_and_politics.md, section 7) writes the call with parameters IDEOLOGY and VALUE; decision E1 says scripted effects take none in 1.19.3, so a tree call compiles to set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ideology = <code> } and set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = <points> } before zin_politics_add_drift = yes. The codes follow the order of the ideology keys (light, dominion, shadow, wild; CONVENTIONS); the politics module reads zin_arg_ideology and zin_arg_value. The spec path is the integration note that proposes the table (docs/design/stage2/focus_shared_a.md). (2) The Concord helper effects (shared_concord_dominions.md, 'Arguments': charter old 0, golden 1, shield 2, free 3, wall 4; camp court 1, faithful 2, dominions 3, host 4 = the values of zin_aenor_ruling_camp), which the Middle Lands tier B trees call; the same table stands in focus_arg_codes_regional_c.json. Same shape as focus_arg_codes.json; loadArgCodes reads this file next to it. Remove an owner when the same prefix is listed in focus_arg_codes.json.
